text:
sam_support: FYI Acme reported a regression after last night's canary. In the same chat session some replies flip between concise and verbose and occasionally drop earlier context. They pasted two consecutive responses that contradict each other. Link redacted.

harry_infra: Do we have routing logs? My first thought is a mid-session variant swap — smart routing might have rerouted when capacity changed.

maria_engineer: Can you paste the exact request payload + headers + session id? If session affinity was lost the request could hit a different model tier. Look for x-variant or model_variant in the logs.

sam_support: Pasting their sample (ids redacted): ```{
  "session_id": "acme-9f8",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the last ticket."}],
  "headers": {"x-routing-preference":"latency"}
}``` They also saw a transient 502 around 2024-06-12T03:12Z.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 'model-v2-alpha' rolled to 10% on eu-west-1-r4 at 2024-06-12T02:55Z. No automatic rollbacks.

maria_engineer: That matches a hypothesis: canary + short capacity pressure => routing fallback to a different model variant mid-session. Quick repro approach: issue multiple requests under the same session id and inspect the serving trace for model_variant changes.

harry_infra: Repro steps I ran locally:
1) create session via /chat with pin_variant=false
2) send a seed message
3) flood a shard with synthetic QPS to trigger evictions
4) tail the serving traces filtered by session id
Commands:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Session-ID: acme-9f8" -X POST -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
# then on infra box
grep "model_variant" /var/log/serving/*.log | grep acme-9f8 | tail -n 50
```

sam_support: Customer tried dropping their session cookie and was able to reproduce the mixed-tone responses. They want immediate mitigations.

maria_engineer: Short-term mitigation: advise them to set header `x-pin-variant: true` or include `session_affinity=true` in the request to keep a session sticky. Also recommend retries with exponential backoff rather than opening a new session. Long-term: propose an RFC to make session pinning opt-out at routing layer and emit clearer trace tags when a cross-variant swap happens.

sam_support: I'll send the pin-variant suggestion and the repro steps. :thumbsup: Will escalate if they still see mismatched outputs.
